SELECT MIN(chn.name) AS character_name,
       MIN(movie_rating.info) AS rating,
       MIN(t.title) AS complete_hero_movie
FROM (
    SELECT mk.movie_id
    FROM keyword AS k
    JOIN movie_keyword AS mk ON mk.keyword_id = k.id
    WHERE k.keyword IN ('superhero', 'marvel-comics', 'based-on-comic', 'tv-special', 'fight', 'violence', 'magnet', 'web', 'claw', 'laser')
) AS keyword_movies
JOIN (
    SELECT mi_idx.movie_id, mi_idx.info
    FROM info_type AS it2
    JOIN movie_info_idx AS mi_idx ON mi_idx.info_type_id = it2.id
    WHERE it2.info = 'rating'
) AS movie_rating ON movie_rating.movie_id = keyword_movies.movie_id
JOIN (
    SELECT cc.movie_id
    FROM complete_cast AS cc
    JOIN comp_cast_type AS cct1 ON cct1.id = cc.subject_id AND cct1.kind = 'cast'
    JOIN comp_cast_type AS cct2 ON cct2.id = cc.status_id AND cct2.kind LIKE '%complete%'
) AS complete_movies ON complete_movies.movie_id = keyword_movies.movie_id
JOIN title AS t ON t.id = keyword_movies.movie_id
JOIN kind_type AS kt ON kt.id = t.kind_id AND kt.kind = 'movie'
JOIN cast_info AS ci ON ci.movie_id = keyword_movies.movie_id
JOIN (
    SELECT id, name
    FROM char_name
    WHERE name IS NOT NULL AND (name LIKE '%man%' OR name LIKE '%Man%')
) AS chn ON chn.id = ci.person_role_id
JOIN name AS n ON n.id = ci.person_id
WHERE t.production_year > 2000
